requirement: Under {cite}`requirements.cli.skill_structure`, the `habeas-evidence` skill MUST be the home of the authoring workflow, fixing validation findings, including uncovered Rust items, outcomes and FIXME judgments, citation and site reviews, disagreeing assessments, and the commit message for a change to agreed requirement text.
rationale:
The subject has one MUST: the `habeas-evidence` skill is the home of six topics. I split it into one obligation per topic. The skill states each one in full, and the test checks each.

| Topic | Where the skill states it | How the test checks it |
|---|---|---|
| Authoring workflow | `assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` section `## Workflow` (`habeas author --all`) | `assert_text` on `section(raw, "## Workflow")` |
| Fixing validation findings | `SKILL.md` section `## Fixing findings`, with its Finding/Action table | `assert_text` on `## Fixing findings` for the table header and `### Uncovered Rust items` |
| Uncovered Rust items | `SKILL.md` section `### Uncovered Rust items` | The same assertion on `## Fixing findings` |
| Outcomes | `SKILL.md` section `## Judgments` ("A judgment is one of three outcomes") | `assert_home("habeas-evidence")`, which requires `home_markers` to include that sentence |
| FIXME judgments | `assets/skills/habeas-evidence/references/fixme.md` ("# FIXME judgments") | `assert_text` on `references/fixme.md`; `assert_home` also checks the "A FIXME judgment, such as" marker |
| Citation and site reviews | `assets/skills/habeas-evidence/references/reviews.md` (`## Citation reviews`, `## Site reviews`) | `assert_text` on `references/reviews.md` |
| Disagreeing assessments | `SKILL.md` section `## Disagreeing assessments` | `assert_text` on that section for "The goal is" |
| Commit message for a change to agreed requirement text | `SKILL.md` section `## Rules`, which says to give the reason in the message of the commit that makes the change | `assert_text` on `## Rules` for "in the message of the commit that makes it" |

The test is `tests/authoring_cli.rs#fn[the_evidence_skill_is_home_of_authoring_findings_and_assessment_outcomes]`. It carries the `{test}` reference to the subject. Its final call, `assert_home`, checks that the home skill contains every marker. It also checks that no other bundled skill contains those markers, so they are not restated elsewhere. The parent requirement `requirements.cli.skill_structure` owns the "exactly one home" rule, so I did not reassess it.

The skill and reference files are text assets, so there is no code to reach. `references/authoring-failures.md` adds guidance beyond the listed topics. It covers authoring failures and falls within the authoring workflow, so it is not an unspecified-behavior gap.

I found no gaps.

text: Under {cite}`requirements.cli.skill_structure`, the `habeas-evidence` skill MUST be the home of the authoring workflow, fixing validation findings, including uncovered Rust items, outcomes and FIXME judgments, citation and site reviews, disagreeing assessments, and the commit message for a change to agreed requirement text.

Habeas's bundled agent skills MUST jointly give the direction that the requirements on them specify. A skill consists of its `SKILL.md` and the files under its `references/` directory. Each topic MUST be stated in full in exactly one skill, its home.
